criteria: Three Provider type annotation imports only; complete original and exact-minimum13-type public closure with52 assignments/26 equalities. Runtime providers and constructor DI remain separate.

reviews.decision: The exact public Provider import is used only as the type annotation on MAT_CHECKBOX_REQUIRED_VALIDATOR. The actual original16.2.12 and advertised-minimum22.1.7/21.2.23 declarations have the same complete13-declaration Provider closure, including every SansProvider and the constructable Type interface. Root import/export aliases and the terminal declaration are authenticated; the unrelated root Type=Function alias is excluded. All52 strict cross-model assignments and26 exact equalities pass. Removing this import preserves diagnostic executable emit under both decorator metadata modes. Eighteen controls reject runtime/constructor/generic/nested/extra/nonconst/wrong/missing/ambiguous references, stale subjects, wrong public alias, removed export, deprecation, changed closure or a new dependency. Close only this type annotation boundary. Provider tokens, initializer values, injector/validator/animation behavior, Angular DI/AOT and native/packed/runtime/compiler/RxJS floor execution remain separate. Product resources and every other authored-use decision are unchanged.
